providers.description: Adentro (formerly Zenreach) is a WiFi marketing and customer-intelligence platform that connects online marketing spend to real-world, in-store visits for brick-and-mortar businesses. Branded guest-WiFi portals capture and enrich first-party customer profiles, measure foot traffic and a "Walk-Through Rate" attribution metric, and power automated email and audience-targeting campaigns across roughly 100 million verified US consumer profiles. Adentro serves retail, food and beverage, venues and arenas, and entertainment and hospitality brands. It exposes a partner/customer-gated Contacts API and a Location & Scanning API (V2/V3) for syncing captured contacts, visits, and location data into CRMs and loyalty platforms such as Fishbowl and Alpine IQ; access is granted via an Adentro-issued token passed in the Authorization header rather than through a public self-serve developer portal.

providers.name: Vastrm
providers.description: Vastrm is a custom-tailored menswear e-commerce company selling made-to-fit polo shirts with 24 different fits and sizes plus additional free adjustments, an online design-your-own configurator, corporate solutions for businesses, and a retail partners program. Vastrm is a Y Combinator and a16z-backed company tracked in the API Evangelist network; it operates a consumer storefront at vastrm.com and publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Weee
providers.description: Weee! is America's largest online Asian grocery store and delivery platform, operating as a direct-to-consumer online supermarket serving major metropolitan areas across the United States. It curates and fulfills inventory through regional distribution centers and cold-chain logistics, bringing together products and ingredients commonly found in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Filipino, and Indian supermarkets. The storefront spans fresh produce, frozen meats, seafood, pantry staples, snacks, sauces, hot pot ingredients, beverages, and household essentials, accepts EBT/SNAP in eligible cities, and runs a multilingual experience (English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Thai). Weee is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile Weee publishes no public developer API; this record captures its public web identity and AI-indexing (llms.txt) surface.

providers.name: Astro Sea
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia), operating at astronauts.id, is an Indonesian quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and everyday essentials in as little as 15 minutes. Its consumer mobile apps (iOS and Android) offer more than 3,000 curated products spanning fresh produce, frozen goods, groceries, beauty, household items, and electronics, with 24/7 service across the Greater Jakarta (JADETABEK) region. Astro is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio into the API Evangelist network. Astro is a business-to-consumer application company; it publishes a consumer app, a corporate site, and an RFC 9116 security contact, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Serve First
providers.description: Serve First is a UK-based AI-driven customer experience (CX) platform that unifies reviews, surveys, receipts, in-location feedback terminals, operational audits, and mystery shopping into a single dashboard. It turns real-time customer feedback into role-based, actionable insight, with sentiment analysis and unified reporting across retail, hospitality, facilities management, health & wellness, and franchise businesses. Serve First also provides Client Connect journey/workflow automation and Martyn's Law public-protection compliance management. Serve First does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures company identity plus verified security and compliance posture (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 via a Sprinto-hosted trust center).

providers.name: The Coca-Cola Company
providers.description: The Coca-Cola Company is the world's largest non-alcoholic beverage company, owning and marketing more than 200 brands across sparkling soft drinks, water, hydration, sports, coffee, tea, juice, dairy, and plant-based drinks. The company sells its products in more than 200 countries through a bottling and distribution partner network. While Coca-Cola does not currently publish a broadly available public REST API, it is a heavy enterprise API consumer running an internal API program on MuleSoft that connects ERP, manufacturing, distribution, retail, marketing, and consumer engagement systems through a Center for Enablement (C4E) model. Historical Coca-Cola Enterprises (CCE) Product and Location APIs at developer.cokecce.com are no longer maintained as a public-facing developer program.

providers.name: Blidz
providers.description: Blidz is a membership-based social and gamified e-commerce platform ("Make Money, Save Money, Have Fun") offering deeply discounted deals across grocery, electronics, home goods, and other consumer categories through its iOS and Android shopping apps. Backed by General Catalyst, Blidz operates a consumer mobile marketplace rather than a public developer platform; as of this profile it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface. This APIs.json profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web domain.

providers.name: Dollar Shave
providers.description: Dollar Shave Club is a direct-to-consumer men's grooming and personal-care brand founded in 2011 and acquired by Unilever in 2016, best known for pioneering the subscription razor model that ships blades, shave butter, skincare and body-care products to members on a recurring schedule. The company sells through its own e-commerce storefront (dollarshaveclub.com, built on Shopify) as well as retail channels, offering razor handles and cartridges, grooming kits and gift sets. It surfaces in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. Dollar Shave Club does not operate a public developer program or documented API; its digital surface is a consumer Shopify storefront whose only machine-discoverable interface is Shopify's customer-account OAuth/OIDC (including a customer-account MCP API scope) exposed at the store's /.well-known/ discovery endpoints.

providers.name: Grove Collaborative
providers.description: Grove Collaborative is a digital-first consumer products company and online marketplace for sustainable everyday household essentials — eco-friendly cleaning supplies, bamboo and recycled paper products, personal care, beauty, pet, and vitamins & supplements from hundreds of vetted brands. Orders meet strict ingredient standards and are carbon neutral, and the company operates as a plastic-neutral, sustainability-focused retailer sold through grove.co (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and retail partners. Grove is a public benefit company (NYSE: GROV) that was an early portfolio company of 500 Global and Bullpen Capital. It publishes no first-party developer API or public developer program; this profile captures its public web, security, and Shopify-platform discovery surface.

providers.name: Mayvenn
providers.description: Mayvenn is an Oakland, California beauty-commerce company that sells quality virgin human hair extensions, sew-in weave bundles, closures, frontals, and human hair wigs directly to consumers and through a network of more than 100,000 hair stylists. Founded by Diishan Imira and backed by a16z and 500 Global, Mayvenn pairs its hair products with a stylist-driven distribution model and a 30-day return policy, running its storefront on Shopify at shop.mayvenn.com. The company does not currently publish a public first-party developer API; this profile captures its web identity, security posture, and commercial link surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Saysh
providers.description: Saysh is a direct-to-consumer athletic footwear and apparel brand founded by Olympic champion sprinter Allyson Felix, designing sneakers engineered specifically for women's biomechanics under the banner "Women Deserve Better." Its lineup spans performance running shoes (the Felix Runner and Evelyn Runner) and the everyday Saysh One, plus apparel, accessories, and the Saysh+ Run Club membership. The saysh.com storefront runs on Shopify, so customer-facing commerce is served through the Shopify platform rather than a first-party Saysh developer API; no public Saysh API program, OpenAPI, SDKs, or developer portal were found. Backed by Redpoint Ventures.

providers.name: Tiff's Treats
providers.description: Tiff's Treats is an Austin, Texas cookie company founded in 1999 by University of Texas students Tiffany Taylor and Leon Chen, built around warm, baked-to-order cookies delivered same-day. The company operates roughly 90 bakery-storefronts across Texas and the southern and western United States, combining walk-in retail with an owned delivery fleet, an online ordering platform at cookiedelivery.com, and iOS and Android ordering apps. Alongside consumer delivery it runs a substantial corporate gifting, catering, e-gift-card and special-events business, plus an "Elites" subscription membership and a rewards program. Tiff's Treats has raised more than $50 million in outside investment, including a $25 million round led by Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital, and counts Andy Roddick, Brooklyn Decker, Kendra Scott and Dirk Nowitzki among its investors. It is a direct-to-consumer food and delivery operator, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Cantaloupe Seed API
providers.description: The Cantaloupe Seed API connects point-of-sale and self-service retail equipment to Cantaloupe's cloud-based vending management platform, enabling cashless payment processing, real-time sales tracking, and consolidated reporting across vending, micro markets, office coffee, and unattended retail channels. Seed APIs compile transactions, fees, and payments into a single bill and expose sales analytics so operators can monitor performance, payment types, and profitability across their fleet.

providers.name: Eloquii
providers.description: ELOQUII is a plus-size women's fashion retailer offering trend-driven, fashion-forward apparel and accessories in sizes 14 through 32, including dresses, workwear, outerwear, denim, and occasion wear with frequent seasonal collection refreshes. Known for its fit-obsessed design and inclusive sizing, the brand operates a direct-to-consumer ecommerce storefront at eloquii.com alongside select retail locations. ELOQUII was founded as a plus-size line, acquired by Walmart in 2018, and is now part of FullBeauty Brands. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes a consumer ecommerce experience but no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Paz Ai
providers.description: Paz.ai is an AI commerce platform that helps merchants win visibility and sales across AI shopping channels such as ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Perplexity. It runs three autonomous agents — a Monitor agent that benchmarks catalog performance across AI channels, an Optimizer agent that enriches product titles, attributes, and structured data, and a Distributor agent that publishes AI-optimized feeds to agentic commerce endpoints — producing an AI-optimized copy of a product catalog without modifying the live store. It integrates with Shopify, Adobe Commerce, and Salesforce Commerce, plus CSV and a custom API on enterprise plans. Backed by Mayfield.

providers.name: PCA SKIN
providers.description: PCA SKIN is a professional skincare brand specializing in dermatologically tested chemical peels and result-oriented corrective products, positioned as a leading professional chemical-peel brand among estheticians and skincare professionals. The brand's direct-to-consumer store at pcaskin.com is built on Shopify and exposes a modern agent-commerce surface: it implements the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) with a hosted MCP endpoint plus read-only storefront JSON, so AI shopping agents can discover the catalog, build carts, and drive buyer-approved checkout. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from the store's published agent surface (/llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp).

providers.name: Sonans
providers.description: Sonans is an AI software company building an intelligence layer for fashion merchandising. Its collaborative AI agents replace manual coordination with autonomous workflows that bridge buying decisions and cross-functional execution, turning raw design sketches and purchase orders into production-ready assets including photorealistic product imagery, marketing copy, and catalog data synchronized across ERPs, Shopify, and B2B commerce platforms. Sonans serves fashion brands and designers (streamlining design cycles, asset enrichment, and multi-channel product launches) as well as retailers and merchants (automating assortment planning, catalog enrichment, and inventory management). The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Sonans operates a web application at app.sonans.ai but publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: TTRacing
providers.description: TTRacing is a Malaysian gaming chair and gaming furniture brand selling ergonomic gaming chairs, office chairs, and accessories through an online Shopify storefront at ttracing.my. The store is agent-commerce ready: it publishes an llms.txt and agents.md with explicit agent instructions, a UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) discovery document at /.well-known/ucp, and a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint that lets AI shopping agents search the catalog, build carts, and run buyer-approved checkout. Human customer accounts are handled via Shopify's OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 authorization server. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched from live probes of its public agent-facing surface.

providers.name: BloomNation
providers.description: BloomNation is a flower-delivery marketplace that connects consumers with independent local florists for same-day and next-day delivery of handcrafted floral arrangements across 40+ U.S. cities and the UK. Customers shop florist-designed bouquets for occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, sympathy, and get-well, then pay with credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, or Afterpay. Distinctive features include BloomSnap photo delivery confirmation and video message cards. BloomNation also runs a florist-facing SaaS side (point-of-sale, website, and order management, now part of Promenade) that powers member shops. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation program was found during enrichment.

providers.name: SpartanNash
providers.description: SpartanNash is a Byron Center, Michigan food solutions company that operates as both a wholesale grocery distributor and a retail grocer. Its wholesale segment supplies roughly 2,100 independent retail locations, national accounts and e-commerce partners from a network of distribution centers, and through its MDV business it is the leading distributor of grocery products to United States military commissaries and exchanges worldwide. Its retail segment operates roughly 200 corporate-owned supermarkets under banners including Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets, D&W Fresh Market, VG's Grocery, Dan's Supermarket, Family Fresh Market, Needler's Fresh Market, Fresh City Market, Forest Hills Foods and Supermercado Nuestra Familia, alongside pharmacy and fuel centers. Formed by the 2013 merger of Spartan Stores and Nash Finch, the company traded on Nasdaq as SPTN until C&S Wholesale Grocers completed its acquisition of SpartanNash on September 22, 2025; SpartanNash now operates as part of C&S and its corporate web properties are progressively being folded into cswg.com. SpartanNash publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; supplier and customer system integration is transacted over EDI through trading-partner onboarding rather than a public API.

providers.name: Stockly
providers.description: Stockly (Stockly SAS, headquartered in Vitry-sur-Seine, France) operates a global inventory network for e-commerce, positioning itself as "the first global inventory for Retail." It connects online retailers that are missing stock (Demanders) with brands and official retailers that hold surplus inventory (Suppliers), detecting out-of-stock variants and filling the gaps in real time so that e-shops never run out of stock. Stockly integrates directly with a retailer's e-commerce infrastructure via API, a CMS, or a marketplace, and is building toward a stock exchange for e-commerce inventory in compliance with brands' distribution policies. The company reports 300+ partnered retailers across Europe and 100M+ available items, and is backed by Techstars. Stockly is primarily a partner-onboarded platform rather than a broad self-serve public developer API.

providers.name: ThredUp
providers.description: ThredUp (NASDAQ: TDUP) is one of the world's largest online resale and consignment platforms for secondhand women's and kids' clothing, shoes, and accessories. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Oakland, CA, it lets consumers buy and sell pre-owned fashion via mailed Clean Out Kits, and powers branded recommerce for 60+ retailers through its Resale-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform. ThredUp does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI; RaaS integrations are arranged through its partner sales team, so this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, engineering, and policy surface rather than a documented API program.

providers.name: TreeHouse Foods
providers.description: TreeHouse Foods is one of the largest manufacturers of private label packaged foods and beverages in North America, producing snack and convenience foods for retail grocery and foodservice customers. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE (THS) and is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois. TreeHouse Foods produces over 1,600 SKUs across snacking, beverage, and meal preparation categories.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: CUUP, Inc.
providers.description: CUUP, Inc. is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer intimates brand founded in 2018 by Abby Morgan and Kearnon O'Molony, offering precision-fit bras, underwear, loungewear, apparel, and swim across an extended range of cup and band sizes sold through its shopcuup.com online store. Backed by Insight Partners and Forerunner Ventures, CUUP was acquired by FULLBEAUTY Brands in July 2023 and now runs on the FULLBEAUTY commerce platform. As a consumer retail company it exposes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures its public web presence, domain security posture, and commercial policy pages.

providers.name: EDITED
providers.description: EDITED is an AI-powered retail intelligence platform that helps retailers, buyers, merchandisers, planners, designers, and eCommerce teams make data-driven decisions across assortment, pricing, and promotions. Its Market API (the EDITED Data product) exposes a large normalized retail market data set — SKUs, brands, categories, pricing, and assortment signals across thousands of retailers and many countries — so organizations can benchmark against competitors in real time, spot emerging trends early, and integrate competitive intelligence into their own systems. The company is a Seedcamp portfolio company; access to the Market API is sales-gated (demo / contact sales) with no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: FirstCry
providers.description: FirstCry (operated by Brainbees Solutions Ltd) is India's largest omnichannel retailer of baby, kids, and maternity products, founded in 2010 by Supam Maheshwari and Amitava Saha and headquartered in Pune, India. It sells apparel, footwear, toys, diapers, feeding and nursery gear, and personal-care products across its website, mobile apps, and a large network of physical stores, alongside in-house brands such as BabyHug. The company is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund and listed publicly on the NSE and BSE in 2024. FirstCry publishes no public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures the company's public web, policy, and security-disclosure surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Halara
providers.description: Halara is a direct-to-consumer athleisure and activewear fashion brand for women, best known for its versatile Active Dress and its Halara Flex fabric technology. Its Shopify-based online store sells exercise dresses, leggings, tennis skirts, joggers, pants, sports bras, loungewear, sweaters, and denim under the tagline "Athleisure for 365 Versions of You." Halara runs a mobile shopping app and a customer loyalty program (The Halara Circle), and is backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Halara publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web, brand, and policy properties for network discovery.

providers.name: Matsmart
providers.description: Matsmart (operating internationally as Motatos) is a Swedish e-commerce company that fights food waste by selling surplus, short-dated, and overstocked groceries and household goods at a discount, with average savings of up to 50%. Its catalog spans pantry staples, beverages, snacks, candy, baby food, health and beauty, cleaning supplies, pet food, and non-food surplus, sourced from manufacturers and retailers and shipped across Sweden and other European markets via partners including Bring, Airmee, and PostNord. The company runs a consumer web storefront and iOS/Android apps. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API or documentation, so this profile captures its public web, security, and identity surface.

providers.name: Plush
providers.description: Plush is an AI-powered fashion discovery and shopping platform at plush.shop that lets shoppers describe what they want in natural language and returns curated results from trusted and emerging brands. Rather than rigid keyword search, Plush matches on mood, aesthetic, and intent, layering image search, smart real-time filters, influencer edit collections, and wishlists on top of its proprietary AI curation. Founded by Chang Liu (CEO) and Ying Zhu (CTO) — who met through Y Combinator's co-founder matching — Plush is backed by the Anthemis Female Innovators Lab Fund and the Oxford Seed Fund. It is a consumer-facing web application; no public developer API is published at this time.

providers.name: AiSensum
providers.description: AiSensum (AISensum) builds agentic AI "teammates" that work alongside front-line staff to drive revenue, improve quality, and reduce labour while keeping the human in the lead. Operating since 2017 with a presence across Southeast Asia, it deploys purpose-built AI teammates for enterprise front-line operations in retail, F&B, hospitality and entertainment, each specialising in one measurable outcome: Daniel (revenue teammate, personalised counter offers/upsell), Sasha (time and cost teammate, bulk product-photo editing and approval), and Nicole (progress teammate, conversation scoring and cashier coaching against brand SOPs). Deployments are scoped through a half-day IFA (Intelligent Front-line Automation) Workshop. AiSensum publishes no public API, SDK, or developer portal; it is a portfolio company of 500 Global tracked in the API Evangelist network. This profile was enriched from the company's public web presence and an on-site llms.txt.

providers.name: Aramya
providers.description: Aramya is a direct-to-consumer (D2C) women's ethnic wear brand from India, operated by DSLR Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Founded by Ankush Goyal, Aramya sells premium cotton kurtas, kurta sets, bottoms, dresses, co-ord sets, and dupattas with a strong focus on inclusive sizing (XS to 10XL) and affordable, comfortable everyday, office, and occasion wear. The brand runs on a Shopify-based storefront at aramya.in with weekly launches, cash on delivery, and free returns, and has raised multiple rounds (seed, pre-Series A, and an ~INR 80 Cr Series A) co-led by Accel India and Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India). Aramya is a consumer retail brand and does not publish a public developer API; it does publish an llms.txt describing its shopping surface for AI assistants.

providers.name: Dagangan
providers.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: FreshToHome
providers.description: FreshToHome (Freshtohome Foods Private Limited) is a Bangalore-headquartered direct-to-consumer e-commerce company selling fresh, antibiotic-residue-free fish, seafood, poultry, mutton, ready-to-cook and heat-and-eat food. Founded in 2015 by Shan Kadavil, Mathew Joseph and Jayesh Jose, it runs its own farm-and-boat-to-doorstep cold chain, sourcing from thousands of fishermen and farmers and delivering across cities in India and the United Arab Emirates. The company sells through its website and its consumer iOS and Android apps. It publishes an llms.txt at its web root but operates no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: HomeLane
providers.description: HomeLane is an Indian end-to-end interior design company that delivers customized home interiors — modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage, bedroom, living room, bathroom, and home-office designs — pairing in-house digital design and 3D visualization tools with material selection and professional installation, backed by a 45-day delivery guarantee on end-to-end modular interiors. Founded in Bangalore and backed by Accel, HomeLane operates across major Indian cities through design studios, a franchise/partner network, and a customer mobile app. HomeLane currently exposes no public developer API; this profile tracks its digital, security, and identity surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Spark Car Wash
providers.description: Spark Car Wash is an express-tunnel car wash operator running a network of high-throughput drive-thru locations across New Jersey, Pennsylvania and New York. The company pairs a conveyorized tunnel — neoglide washers, custom non-acidic cleaning formulas, high-intensity dryers, and a closed-loop water reclamation and filtration system — with self-service "Spark Park" terminals offering multi-nozzle vacuums, anti-scratch towels and automated mat cleaners. Revenue is driven by unlimited-wash memberships sold in Standard, Select and Signature tiers, with additional-vehicle discounts, alongside single-wash purchases. Membership signup and account management run on a third-party hosted portal rather than a Spark-operated application. Spark Car Wash is a physical services operator: it publishes no developer program, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Three Chord Bourbon
providers.description: Three Chord Bourbon, Inc. is an American whiskey blending house founded in 2017 by Rock & Roll Hall of Fame guitarist, producer and songwriter Neil Giraldo, who serves as founder, creative director and chairman. The company blends straight bourbon whiskeys aged a minimum of four years using a proprietary process it calls "Perfectly Tuned Taste," and has extended the line into rye and cask-finished expressions including a pinot noir cask finish and the Amplify rye. Product is co-packed at Ugly Dog Distillery in Chelsea, Michigan, and the corporate office is in Clarence, New York. The brand sells through wholesale distribution and a direct-to-consumer online store at store.threechordbourbon.com. It is a consumer packaged goods company: it publishes no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: Amer Sports
providers.description: Amer Sports is a global group of premium sports and outdoor brands with Nordic roots and more than 75 years of history, employing roughly 15,400 people and selling products in over 100 countries. Its portfolio spans ten brands including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, Atomic, Armada, ATEC, DeMarini, EvoShield and Louisville Slugger, covering technical apparel, footwear, winter sports, racquet sports and ball sports equipment. Amer Sports was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). As a consumer sports and outdoor manufacturer it publishes a corporate and investor web presence and a security.txt contact, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Astro
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia, astronauts.id) is an Indonesian quick-commerce grocery and daily-needs delivery service that fulfills orders in as little as fifteen minutes across the Greater Jakarta (Jadetabek) area. The consumer mobile app offers more than 15,000 SKUs spanning fresh produce, meat and seafood, frozen and prepared meals, beverages, snacks, baby and maternal care, personal care and beauty, household supplies, and the private-label Astro Goods line, operating 24/7 from a network of dark stores. Astro is venture-backed by Accel, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. It is a consumer B2C app and publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Califia Farms
providers.description: Califia Farms, LLC is a Los Angeles, California based plant-based beverage company founded in 2010 by Greg Steltenpohl and named for the mythical Queen Califia. It manufactures and distributes non-dairy oatmilks, almondmilks and organic soymilks, coffee creamers, barista blends, cold brew coffees and teas, and ready-to-drink creamy refreshers, sold through grocery retail, foodservice distribution and direct-to-consumer channels across North America and Europe. Its public web presence is a marketing, recipe and where-to-buy site built on Gatsby and hosted on Netlify; the company publishes no developer program, no API documentation, and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Girlboss
providers.description: Girlboss is a community and media brand for ambitious women, positioned as a navigator for the future of work — created to spark the thrill of possibility and to inspire and inform so members can find success on their own terms. Founded by Sophia Amoruso (author of #GIRLBOSS and founder of Nasty Gal), Girlboss grew from editorial content, newsletters, and the Girlboss Rally events into a community brand. Today girlboss.com runs as a Shopify-hosted storefront and brand site. Girlboss was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners; it publishes no first-party developer API, so this profile captures its public web, policy, and agent-facing (llms.txt / well-known) surface rather than an API.

providers.name: Stitch Fix
providers.description: Stitch Fix is an online personal styling service that pairs data science and machine learning with expert human stylists to send customers curated shipments ("Fixes") of apparel, footwear, and accessories selected to their size, budget, and style preferences. Founded in 2011 and publicly traded (NASDAQ: SFIX), the company operates a direct-to-consumer retail model across womens, mens, and kids categories. Stitch Fix does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its engineering team shares its data-science and platform work through the Multithreaded technology blog and open-source projects on GitHub. This profile captures the company's public web, security, and engineering surfaces.

providers.name: Capri Holdings
providers.description: Capri Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Capri Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Cimulate
providers.description: Cimulate is an AI-native commerce experience platform for intelligent product discovery, delivering context-aware search, adaptive browse, real-time recommendations, a conversational AI shopping assistant, and Commerce AEO (answer/agent engine optimization for visibility inside LLM surfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude). The platform is architected API-first and headless-ready and advertises a proprietary Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agentic commerce workflows. Cimulate became part of Salesforce in February 2026. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Sierra Ventures.

providers.name: Efreshli
providers.description: Efreshli is a Cairo, Egypt based online home-furnishing and interior-design commerce platform founded in 2018 by Heba El Gabaly. The company lets consumers design and shop their space online, pairing an e-commerce catalog of furniture, decor, lighting, rugs, bedding, and kitchen and dining goods with AI-assisted room design tools, curated collections, a gift registry, an Efreshli Pro membership, and a B2B / trade program that connects a network of vendors and brands. Efreshli is backed by 500 Global, Algebra Ventures, Marakez, and angel investor Tarek Sakr. This profile is a company record in the API Evangelist network; Efreshli operates a consumer e-commerce web storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: Ethan Allen Interiors
providers.description: Ethan Allen Interiors is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ethan Allen Interiors API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: FlagshipRTL
providers.description: FlagshipRTL (Flagship) is a SaaS company providing AI-powered inventory forecasting and merchandise planning software for retail brands, with a focus on apparel and direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Its platform pairs demand forecasting at size-level granularity with multi-scenario planning, a purchase-order (PO) builder, and real-time inventory alerts to help retailers reduce stockouts and maximize full-price sell-through. Flagship reports optimizing over $2B in GMV for customers such as Bala, Mack Weldon, and Fresh Clean Threads, and integrates with systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Cin7, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. Backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: Fortune Brands Innovations
providers.description: Fortune Brands Innovations is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortune Brands Innovations API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: MOO
providers.description: MOO is a London-founded online print and design company that produces premium custom business cards, postcards, flyers, stickers, notebooks, packaging, and branded promotional merchandise for individuals and businesses. Backed by Index Ventures, MOO combines a browser-based design experience with commercial printing, and sells tiered business plans (Business, Advanced, Enterprise) with team management and design services. MOO does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; its developer-style subdomains resolve to the main storefront rather than an API surface. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Petco Animal Supplies
providers.description: Petco Animal Supplies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Petco Animal Supplies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: BARK (BarkBox)
providers.description: BARK, Inc. (operating as BarkBox) is a New York-based dog-focused consumer company founded in 2011 by Henrik Werdelin and Matt Meeker, serving over two million dogs monthly through its BarkBox and Super Chewer subscription boxes, the BARK Bright dental line, the BARK Air pet travel experience, and retail distribution. The company went public via a SPAC merger in 2021 (NYSE: BARK). BarkBox does not operate a public developer program or externally documented API portal; its engineering surface is a set of mostly-internal Ruby services and open-source libraries published under the github.com/barkbox organization (including the barkbox_client Ruby API client and cursor-pagination gems). This profile was surfaced as a Slow Ventures portfolio company and enriched with verified public identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Booko
providers.description: Booko is an Australian book, eBook, audiobook, DVD, music and collectibles price-comparison service operating since 2007. It aggregates new and used prices across many online retailers and regions, calculates shipping, and converts international prices to the shopper's local currency to surface the cheapest place to buy a title. Booko also offers shopping lists with bundled shipping calculations, barcode scanning, reading lists, price alerts and notifications. It is a consumer-facing comparison site rather than a retailer or a public API provider, earning referral fees from partner shops (including Amazon Associates) when shoppers buy through its links. Booko is a solo developer-run product surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio company.

providers.name: Cado Gifts, Inc.
providers.description: Cado Gifts, Inc. (CADO Gifting) is a luxury and corporate gifting company operating a Shopify-hosted direct-to-consumer storefront at cadogifting.com, serving the UAE and international markets with curated executive, host, and occasion gift collections plus a corporate/bulk gifting program. The business runs on Shopify (customer accounts, checkout, and blog/journal content) rather than a first-party public API; it was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No developer program, OpenAPI, or public API documentation is published; the only machine surface discovered is Shopify's Customer Account OIDC/OAuth well-known documents served under the store's own host.

providers.name: Focal Systems
providers.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.

providers.name: MOD Pizza
providers.description: MOD Pizza is a Seattle-based fast-casual restaurant chain built around individually sized, made-to-order artisan-style pizzas and salads sold at one fixed price regardless of how many of its 40-plus toppings, finishing sauces and dressings a guest chooses. The company operates and franchises hundreds of locations across the United States and runs a digital guest surface consisting of a WordPress marketing site, a Yext-powered store locator, a Koala-powered online ordering storefront at orders.modpizza.com, and a Punchh-powered MOD Rewards loyalty app on iOS and Android. MOD Pizza is a consumer of restaurant-technology APIs rather than a publisher of them: as of this profiling pass it operates no developer program, publishes no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL or MCP contract, and exposes no partner or franchisee API documentation on any host it controls. Delivery is fulfilled through third-party marketplaces such as DoorDash rather than a first-party delivery API.

providers.name: Novi
providers.description: Novi Connect is an AI shopping optimization platform for consumer packaged goods (CPG) and retail brands. Its AI Shopping Optimizer structures and optimizes product data feeds so that AI systems, agentic search, and commerce assistants can accurately understand, trust, and recommend products, while its Product Authority Builder verifies and distributes product data through direct feeds with major retailers and marketplaces. Novi Connect is backed by Cowboy Ventures and Greylock.

providers.name: Oriient
providers.description: Oriient provides software-only, hardware-free indoor positioning ("indoor GPS") and navigation delivered as a SaaS SDK. Its geomagnetic technology reaches roughly 1-meter (3-foot) accuracy indoors without Wi-Fi, beacons, or installed infrastructure, powering product finding, order picking, visitor navigation, asset tracking, and in-store analytics for retail, grocery, and smart-building customers across thousands of locations. Oriient New Media Ltd is based in Tel Aviv and is a Techstars portfolio company. Oriient ships first-party mobile SDKs (including a React-Native Product Location AI package on npm) rather than a public REST API; integration is gated behind a customer dashboard and sales.

providers.name: Qsic
providers.description: Qsic (styled QSIC) is an Australian-founded, AI-driven in-store audio and retail media platform, headquartered in Melbourne with a North American office in Dallas, Texas. The platform blends curated music, targeted audio advertising and store-level intelligence, deploying either over a retailer's existing speaker infrastructure or over premium smart speakers, and adapting playback to ambient conditions, dayparts and shopper behaviour. Qsic sells three connected products — In-Store Audio, Ads and Intelligence — and positions the combination as a way to turn physical stores into measurable retail media networks with store-level performance reporting and demand-side platform integration. Publicly reported deployments include 7-Eleven ("Gulp Radio"), Dollar General, Coles Liquor and Mecca. Qsic runs a live JSON API host at api.getqsic.com and a Vanta-hosted trust center, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification as of this profile.

providers.name: Udaan
providers.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

providers.name: Yoona.ai
providers.description: Yoona.ai is an enterprise agentic-AI platform for product innovation, originally built for the fashion industry. It creates an adaptive "Enterprise Twin" of a brand by connecting PLM, ERP, e-commerce and market data into a single intelligence layer, then uses AI agents to autonomously generate product designs, optimize assortments and validate sell-through. Capabilities include text-to-image and sketch-to-design generation, trend and data analysis, and a Sales Confidence Algorithm. Integration with a customer's stack (Shopify to SAP) is offered via a flexible REST/GraphQL API, but that API is delivered as an Enterprise-tier custom integration — there is no public self-serve API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification published as of this enrichment pass. Backed by Techstars.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: LAP Coffee
providers.description: LAP Coffee (Life Among People) is a Berlin-founded specialty coffee retail chain operated by Micro Retail Technologies MRT GmbH. It opened its first store in Berlin Mitte in August 2023 and has grown to a network of neighbourhood cafes across Berlin, with further locations and openings in Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and Hamburg. LAP serves locally roasted specialty coffee at everyday prices from small, high-throughput stores, and runs a consumer mobile app (LAP: Everyday Coffee) for pre-ordering, in-store pickup, a stamps and rewards loyalty program, gifting and referrals, replacing an earlier Apple/Google Wallet stamp pass. LAP is backed by HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass LAP publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or developer documentation; its technology surface is the consumer app, the order.lap.coffee deep-link service and a Webflow marketing site.

providers.name: Urbanic
providers.description: Urbanic is an online fast-fashion retailer selling women's apparel and accessories through app-first, localized storefronts, including in.urbanic.com for India and mx.urbanic.com for Mexico, with local payment methods such as Paytm, BHIM, RuPay, OXXO, SPEI, Pix, and Boleto. A portfolio company of D1 Capital, Urbanic is a consumer ecommerce business: its storefront runs on a first-party consumer API (api-shop-in.urbanic.com), but it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Murphy USA
providers.description: Murphy USA (NYSE: MUSA) is a Fortune 500 retailer of gasoline and convenience merchandise, headquartered in El Dorado, Arkansas. The company operates roughly 1,700 Murphy USA and Murphy Express stores across a 27-state footprint in the southern and midwestern United States, most of them sited in or adjacent to Walmart Supercenter parking lots, and it also owns the QuickChek chain of fresh convenience stores in New Jersey and New York. Its fuel slate spans E-10, E-15, FlexFuel (E85), ethanol-free E0, ULSD diesel, biodiesel and winterized diesel, marketed alongside a FuelAssure fuel-quality monitoring program. Consumer digital engagement runs through the Murphy Drive Rewards loyalty app and a Business Fuel Card program. Murphy USA publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: PharmaCann
providers.description: PharmaCann is one of the largest vertically integrated cannabis companies in the United States, founded in 2014 and operating cultivation centers, processing facilities and retail dispensaries across eight states — Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania. The company runs nine cultivation and processing facilities (Denver CO, Dwight IL, Lothian and Stevensville MD, Holliston MA, Warren MI, Hamptonburgh NY, Buckeye Lake OH and Olyphant PA) and sells through two retail banners, LivWell (Colorado and Michigan) and Verilife (Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Ohio and Pennsylvania), alongside a house of product brands including Matter, Magnitude, Full Melt, CAM, P3, LivWell Flower, Hash and PC Nursery. PharmaCann is a physical-goods operator in a federally restricted, state-regulated industry; it publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Djust
providers.description: DJUST is a French all-in-one, modular B2B commerce platform that helps distributors, wholesalers, manufacturers and retailers launch and automate their B2B eCommerce and eProcurement operations. The platform covers automated order management (24/7 online ordering), AI-assisted quoting with automatic pricing and discounts, integrated online payments with deadline tracking, a conversational AI sales assistant, real-time sales analytics, and prebuilt ERP/CRM integrations. Customers include Eiffage, Auchan Retail and Lesaffre; DJUST reports EUR 1.5B GMV and 2M orders processed in 2025. Backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Pharmapacks
providers.description: Pharmapacks was a New York-based e-commerce marketplace seller and third-party logistics operator, founded in 2010 in Long Island City, that grew into one of the largest independent sellers of health, beauty and personal-care goods on Amazon, eBay and Walmart Marketplace. The company rebranded as Packable Holdings LLC in 2021, agreed a SPAC merger with Highland Transcend Partners I Corp. that was abandoned in March 2022, and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on 2022-08-28 before ceasing operations and liquidating substantially all of its assets. Its differentiator was an internal "Master Brain" marketplace-listing, repricing and fulfillment platform, but that technology was operated as an internal system and was never published as a public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, SDK, webhook catalog or machine-readable contract has ever been found on any host the company controlled. The pharmapacks.com domain is today a GoDaddy parking lander. A successor brand operating as Packable at packable.com, led by Pharmapacks/Packable co-founder Jonathan Webb, sells fulfillment, logistics and digital-enablement services and likewise publishes no public API.

providers.name: Presti
providers.description: Presti (operated by Teker AI SAS, France) is an AI agent platform for automated product image and video production at scale. eCommerce teams, retailers, and brands write plain-language briefs — attaching product images, packshots, CSVs, or inspiration URLs — and Presti generates studio-quality product staging, 360-degree spins, image-to-video, close-ups, variants, dimension overlays, and infographics, then routes them through a collaborative review-and-approval workspace. It orchestrates multiple third-party generative models (Google Gemini and Veo, OpenAI GPT Image, Flux, Kling, Seedance, Grok, Photoroom) and encodes visual identity via reusable Brand Skills. API access is offered on the Enterprise plan but is not publicly documented.

providers.name: Smalls
providers.description: Smalls is a New York City based direct-to-consumer pet food company founded in 2017 by Matt Michaelson and Calvin Bohn, selling gently cooked human-grade fresh cat food, freeze-dried raw and treats on a personalized monthly subscription that customers build through an onboarding quiz at smalls.com, shipped nationwide and, since 2023, also sold into brick-and-mortar retail and wholesale. The company had raised roughly $34 million as of March 2023 — including a $9M Series A round announced in 2020 and a $19M Series B closed in mid-2022 — from investors including Left Lane Capital, Founder Collective, Digitalis Ventures and R/GA Ventures, and its shares trade on the Forge Global secondary market. Smalls runs its own Remix storefront on Netlify backed by a Contentful CMS rather than a hosted commerce platform, and publishes no first-party developer program: contract discovery in August 2026 found no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL endpoint, MCP server, A2A agent card, llms.txt or /.well-known documents on any smalls.com host, and no GitHub organization or public client library.

providers.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
providers.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is a specialty grocery retailer focused on fresh, natural, and organic foods at affordable prices. Operating primarily in the western United States, Sprouts integrates with third-party platforms including Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for online grocery delivery. Sprouts uses EDI-based supply chain integrations and participates in Instacart's AI-powered Cart Assistant program. There is no public developer API; integrations are handled through EDI and third-party delivery platform partnerships.

providers.name: Tapestry
providers.description: Tapestry is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Tapestry API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Afresh Technologies
providers.description: Afresh Technologies builds an AI platform for grocery retail that helps supermarkets and distributors manage fresh food, reducing shrink, improving in-stock rates, and cutting food waste across store ordering, inventory management, production planning, recipe management, and distribution-center buying. Its machine-learning decision engine forecasts demand for perishable, random-weight, and bulk items where operational data is inherently messy, and is also offered as a backend Replenishment API that plugs Afresh's forecasting and ordering logic into a retailer's existing front-end systems without changing in-store associate workflows. The company is based in San Francisco and is backed by Insight Partners.

providers.name: autone
providers.description: autone is an AI-powered inventory management platform for retail brands, blending machine-driven recommendations with merchandising expertise and a brand's own data to optimize stock decisions across buying, reordering, replenishment, and rebalancing. Its modules — Buy, Reorder, Replenish, Rebalance, Assortment & Initial Allocation, and Insights — help fashion, beauty, furniture, and sports retailers reduce stockouts and overstock, redistribute inventory across locations, and improve margins. Founded by supply-chain operators from luxury fashion houses (Alexander McQueen, Victoria Beckham, Givenchy), autone is backed by General Catalyst, Seedcamp, and Speedinvest. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; the platform is delivered as an enterprise SaaS. This profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead and has been enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Bloomscape
providers.description: Bloomscape is a direct-to-consumer houseplant company that grows plants in its own greenhouses and ships them fully grown directly to customers' doors, bypassing traditional retail and nursery supply chains. Alongside houseplants, it sells planters, plant-care accessories, and gifting options, and backs every order with its Grow-How team of horticultural experts plus a plant guarantee. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and added to the API Evangelist network. Bloomscape operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its public web, support, and legal properties along with a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Blue Nile
providers.description: Blue Nile is an online retailer of diamonds and fine jewelry, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It pioneered the direct-to-consumer model for engagement rings and loose diamonds, letting shoppers search and compare certified diamonds by cut, color, clarity, and carat and build custom rings, wedding bands, and gifts online. The company is now part of Signet Jewelers. Blue Nile is included in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / e-commerce company profile; it was originally surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Trinity Ventures. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cashify
providers.description: Cashify is an Indian re-commerce platform for buying, selling, and repairing used and refurbished consumer electronics — smartphones, laptops, tablets, and other gadgets. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gurugram, the company provides instant online price quotes, free doorstep pickup with on-the-spot payment for devices sold to it, and sells certified refurbished devices backed by warranty. Alongside its consumer website and mobile apps, Cashify operates a network of physical retail stores across India, runs device repair services, and offers a partner program for retailers. It is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners among other investors. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead and has been enriched with identity and domain-security artifacts.

providers.name: Coach
providers.description: Coach is a luxury leather goods and lifestyle brand offering handbags, accessories, footwear, ready-to-wear apparel, and fragrances. Coach is owned by Tapestry, Inc. (NYSE: TPR), the New York-based house of accessible luxury brands that also operates Kate Spade New York and Stuart Weitzman. Coach operates direct-to-consumer e-commerce at coach.com and a global network of retail and outlet stores. Coach does not publish a public-facing developer portal or API; integrations with retail partners, marketplaces, and ad tech platforms run through Tapestry's enterprise systems and approved partner channels rather than a self-service developer program.

providers.name: DESERT FARMS INC.
providers.description: Desert Farms Inc. is a direct-to-consumer camel milk brand founded in 2013 by Walid Abdul-Wahab and headquartered in Santa Monica, California. The company sources 100% pure camel milk from a network of small family-owned camel dairies across the United States and sells raw and pasteurized camel milk, frozen and powdered camel milk, plus camel-milk-based soaps and skincare, direct to consumers through its Shopify storefront at desertfarms.com and through select retail grocers. Backed by 500 Global, Desert Farms is a consumer packaged goods and e-commerce company rather than an API provider; it exposes no first-party developer API. Its public web surface runs on Shopify, whose Customer Account API OpenID Connect discovery documents are served on the storefront domain for customer login. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched with the domain-security, well-known, and site link-property signals that are genuinely present.

providers.name: Dia
providers.description: Dia & Co is a plus-size fashion and personal styling subscription service for women, operated by FullBeauty Brands. Customers complete an online style quiz, and stylists curate a monthly box of up to seven clothing items in sizes 10 to 32 from hundreds of brands to try on at home, with free shipping and free returns both ways. Dia & Co also runs an online shop and has been featured in Vogue, Forbes, and Glamour, and was an early portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. It operates as a consumer e-commerce brand and publishes no public developer API; this profile tracks its web and security surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Faire
providers.description: Faire is a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands. The Faire External API v2 supports both sides of the marketplace: brand-side endpoints for products, orders, inventory, and shipments, and retailer-side endpoints for browsing and ordering.

providers.name: Fy
providers.description: Fy! (iamfy.co) is an online marketplace for wall art and home decor, curating canvas prints, framed prints, gallery wall sets, and handmade UK-manufactured frames from a community of independent artists. The storefront runs on Shopify and offers an AI-powered "Advisor" tool for personalized wall-design recommendations, an art-for-business program, and an artists hub for creators. Fy was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It publishes no first-party developer API; the only machine-readable surface reachable on the domain is the Shopify Customer Account OIDC/OAuth discovery served by the platform.

providers.name: Honeylove
providers.description: Honeylove Sculptwear Inc. is a Los Angeles-based, venture-backed direct-to-consumer apparel brand founded in 2018 that designs and sells shapewear, bras, bodysuits, leggings, and intimates engineered with targeted "smart compression" panels that support the body without over-squeezing. Sold primarily through its Shopify-powered online store at honeylove.com, the company has grown to millions of customers, was named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies, and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator. Honeylove operates as a consumer e-commerce retailer and does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile captures its public web, policy, and support surface for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jago Coffee
providers.description: Jago Coffee is an Indonesian mobile coffee company operating a fleet of electric-vehicle coffee carts ("Jagoans") that bring freshly brewed specialty coffee, tea, and seasonal drinks directly to neighborhoods across Indonesia. Billing itself as the "#1 Cafe on Wheels," Jago lets customers order through its mobile app with no delivery fees or order minimums, paying with GoPay or OVO digital wallets, using Arabica beans sourced directly from local Indonesian farmers. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer coffee-delivery business; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Little Freddie
providers.description: Little Freddie (Sunny Fields Enterprise Ltd) is a UK-based organic baby and toddler food brand producing nutritious weaning products for infants from six months, developed with a paediatric dietitian to meet UK and EU baby-food guidelines. Its ranges include Greek-style yoghurts, Simply Fruit purees, Full of Veg meals, dairy-free alternatives, home-style meals and omega-3 "Good for Brains" options, sold through major UK retailers including Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Co-op, Ocado, Booths and Spar. The company also runs a Parenting Hub with weaning, nutrition and parenting content. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; this profile currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Martie
providers.description: Martie is a woman-owned, San Francisco-based online discount grocery marketplace founded in 2021 to fight food waste and make quality goods accessible and affordable. Martie works directly with brands on their overstock, surplus, seasonal, and old-packaging inventory — pantry staples, beauty, and household goods — and resells it to consumers at up to 80% off retail with no membership or subscription required. Shoppers browse daily deals through the martie.com website or the Martie iOS and Android apps. The company reports having diverted over five million pounds of food from landfill since launch. Martie is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (a Shopify-hosted storefront) and does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or documentation surface; this profile was surfaced as a Seedcamp portfolio company and enriched with company identity plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Mejuri
providers.description: Mejuri is a direct-to-consumer fine jewelry brand founded in Toronto that designs and sells everyday fine jewelry — rings, earrings, necklaces and bracelets — direct to consumers through its e-commerce site, mobile app, and a growing network of retail stores across North America, Australia, and the United Kingdom. The company also runs the Mejuri+ membership program, offers in-store ear piercing services, and hosts community events. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, this profile has been through the enrichment pipeline: Mejuri operates a consumer-facing commerce experience and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: nabfly
providers.description: nabfly, Inc., doing business as Bespoke Post, is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer e-commerce and subscription retailer founded in 2011 and backed by 500 Global. It sells rugged-meets-refined menswear and lifestyle gear, designing its own brands (including Line of Trade, Fieldworth, Halfday, Wren, Ash and Fir, and Marcellin) and curating products from small independent makers. Alongside a standard online store, it runs an optional membership offering member pricing, early access, and curated monthly boxes. The company operates as a consumer retail brand at bespokepost.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, public web properties, and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Pluto Brand
providers.description: Pluto (Plutopillow) is a Los Angeles-based direct-to-consumer sleep wellness brand best known for the Pluto Pillow, a made-to-order pillow custom-built around each customer's unique sleep profile via an online sleep quiz. The company also sells the PUFF body pillow, the POD travel pillow, and temperature-regulating bedding, and offers a 125-night risk-free trial with free shipping and returns. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network, Pluto is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer platform, API, SDKs, or partner-integration surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties for discovery.

providers.name: Rossignol
providers.description: Rossignol is a French outdoor sports equipment and apparel manufacturer (Rossignol Group), one of the world's best-known makers of alpine skis, cross-country skis, snowboards, bindings, boots, poles, helmets and goggles, alongside a growing range of apparel, footwear, mountain bikes and accessories. Founded in Voiron, France, the company sells direct-to-consumer through localized e-commerce storefronts across 40+ countries and regions. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; this pass enriched it as a consumer brand with a public e-commerce presence but no public developer, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Taylor & Hart
providers.description: Taylor & Hart is a luxury bespoke jewellery company specialising in custom engagement rings and wedding bands, crafted made-to-order in London with showrooms in London and New York. The company pairs an in-house design team with in-person and virtual consultations, ethical gemstone and diamond sourcing, and a customer-led custom design experience. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As a direct-to-consumer luxury retail business, Taylor & Hart publishes a public website, blog, and standard legal pages, but exposes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook/event surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Thrive Causemetics
providers.description: Thrive Causemetics is a direct-to-consumer, cause-driven beauty brand selling cosmetics (makeup) under the Thrive Causemetics label and skincare under its Bigger Than Beauty Skincare line. The company operates a Shopify-based e-commerce storefront with a loyalty/rewards program, subscriptions, and referral offers, and donates products and funds to charitable partners with every purchase. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Trinity Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Thrive Causemetics publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine discovery surface; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Another
providers.description: Another is an AI-native software platform that modernizes off-channel and off-price inventory operations for fashion, beauty, and retail brands. Founded in 2024 by Corina Marshall, the platform connects to a retailer's existing systems - including returns management - to create a single source of truth for excess, returned, and pre-loved goods, then automates how brands identify, manage, and monetize that inventory across downstream channels. Teams can invite and connect with secondary merchandise recipients, send inventory proposals to buyers, request payment from partners, and let partners request inventory, replacing fragmented manual workflows spread across teams, buyers, channels, and partners. Another closed a $2.5M seed round in January 2026 co-led by Anthemis and Westbound. As of this profile the company operates a private, invite-based web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

providers.name: HelprNow
providers.description: HelprNow (operating as Giftr, by Helpr Asia) is Malaysia's leading online gift marketplace, helping people improve relationships with loved ones through a seamless gifting experience. It delivers flowers, cakes, balloons, chocolates, personalised gifts, hampers and gift cards with same-day and nationwide delivery options. The storefront runs on Shopify (helpr-asia.myshopify.com), so its public technical surface is a consumer commerce site rather than a developer API program; the only machine-discoverable interfaces are Shopify's customer-account OAuth2/OpenID Connect endpoints served under giftr.my/.well-known/. Backed by 500 Global; profiled in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: HijUp
providers.description: HijUp is an Indonesia-based modest-fashion e-commerce marketplace selling Muslim women's clothing online — abayas, blouses, dresses, tunics, printed scarves, hijabs, mukena, khimar, and related accessories — aggregating a large catalog of local Indonesian modest-wear brands (over a hundred labels listed under its brands directory) into a single storefront with international shipping. The company operates a consumer-facing shopping site (product catalog, categories, cart, checkout, and customer accounts) rather than a public developer platform; it publishes no API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. HijUp is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Public contact is customer@hijup.com and +6221-78-24-001.

providers.name: Goat Group
providers.description: Goat Group is the parent company behind a family of global marketplaces for sneakers, apparel, and luxury goods, operating the GOAT marketplace and app (goat.com), the Flight Club consignment stores and site, the Grailed peer-to-peer menswear and streetwear community, and the alias B2B platform. Founded in 2015 by Eddy Lu and Daishin Sugano and headquartered in Los Angeles (Culver City), California, the company began as a sneaker marketplace that pioneered ship-to-verify authentication and grew into one of the largest platforms for buying and selling new and pre-owned style. Goat Group went through Y Combinator (Winter 2015) and has raised capital from investors including D1 Capital Partners, Park West Asset Management, Foot Locker, Index Ventures, and others. The company does not currently publish a public developer API program; this profile is a network identity record.

providers.name: Lovevery
providers.description: Lovevery is a direct-to-consumer children's brand that designs stage-based Play Kits, books, and learning products for infants and toddlers, grounded in child-development research. It operates a Shopify-backed e-commerce and subscription storefront at lovevery.com with a customer help center, blog, and careers site. Surfaced as a portfolio company of GV (Google Ventures) and added to the API Evangelist network, Lovevery publishes no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Thrasio
providers.description: Thrasio is a consumer products company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Walpole, Massachusetts, that acquires and operates e-commerce-native consumer brands — principally Amazon marketplace sellers — and then scales them with data science, supply-chain and marketing operations. The company states it is one of Amazon's top five sellers, that its products reach more than 80 million households, and that it sells across 150+ retailers. Thrasio is a brand aggregator and operator rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, no SDKs and no machine-readable specifications, and its own marketplace integrations run over Amazon's Selling Partner API rather than over any Thrasio-published interface.

providers.name: Brooks Brothers
providers.description: Brooks Brothers is a historic American clothier founded in 1818 in New York City by Henry Sands Brooks, defining classic American tailored menswear, womenswear, and boyswear. After filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy on July 8, 2020 amid the COVID-19 pandemic, the brand was acquired in September 2020 by SPARC Group, a joint venture of Authentic Brands Group and Simon Property Group. SPARC subsequently merged with JCPenney in January 2025 to form Catalyst Brands, the brand's current operating parent. Brooks Brothers operates roughly 150 retail stores plus an e-commerce presence at brooksbrothers.com.

providers.name: J Hilburn
providers.description: J.Hilburn is a Dallas, Texas based direct-to-consumer custom menswear brand founded in 2007. It designs and sells made-to-measure suits, shirts, trousers, polos and outerwear through a network of roughly 1,000 independent personal stylists and a small number of studio spaces rather than traditional retail stores. Its public technology surface is consumer- and stylist-facing rather than developer-facing: a catalog and checkout storefront at jhilburn.com, a stylist recruiting and training site at stylist.jhilburn.com, and two iOS applications, J.Hilburn Stylist and J.Hilburn VMA (Virtual Measuring App). J.Hilburn publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API description; the only API surfaces evident from the public web are private, undocumented internal endpoints that the company's own robots.txt disallows crawlers from reaching.

providers.name: Primary
providers.description: Primary (Primary Kids, Inc.) is a direct-to-consumer children's apparel brand selling simple, slogan-free, mix-and-match clothing "in all colors, for all kids" — babies through age 14, plus adult sizes, swimwear, school uniforms and licensed Sesame Street collaborations. The company operates a Shopify-hosted online store at primary.com and is a portfolio company of Homebrew. Primary has no first-party developer API, but its storefront is agent-accessible: it serves a live hosted Shopify Storefront MCP server (catalog search, product lookup, cart, checkout, policy/FAQ lookup) and exposes Shopify's Customer Account API (OAuth2/OIDC) for customer-scoped operations, along with a published llms.txt agent-instructions document.

providers.name: Blank Street
providers.description: Blank Street is a consumer coffee and beverage retailer that began in 2020 as a single 5x10 coffee cart in Brooklyn and has grown into a global brand operating roughly 90+ locations across the United States and the United Kingdom, serving seasonal specialty drinks such as matcha and espresso beverages. The company emphasizes convenience through mobile ordering and a loyalty rewards program via its consumer app, alongside merchandise and gifting. It is backed by General Catalyst and Tiger Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company. Blank Street publishes a consumer web and mobile experience (rewards, ordering, shop, locations, help center) but exposes no public developer API, SDK, or specification surface at this time; this profile captures its public web properties and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Camp
providers.description: CAMP is a family experience company operating immersive, rotating themed retail-and-play venues ("The Family Experience Store") across eleven U.S. markets — Atlanta, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York City, Philadelphia, and Washington D.C. It blends hands-on crafts, counselor-led immersive activities, character meet-and-greets, birthday parties, and a curated toy retail store both in-store and through its online shop. CAMP is a venture-backed consumer brand (investors include Bullpen Capital) and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it does not currently publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Carter's
providers.description: Carter's is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Carter's API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Coveti
providers.description: Coveti is a curated luxury fashion marketplace that connects consumers with independent designers and exclusive heritage boutiques across Milan and Paris through what it calls "Agentic Commerce" - AI-powered personal styling. Its Fashion Agent builds looks for specific occasions, while The Blind Network sources from 500+ boutiques, offering global shipping to 190+ countries, duty handling, custom 3D shoe design, and private client concierge services. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and tracked in the API Evangelist network; no public developer/API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Flashfood
providers.description: Flashfood is a Toronto-based mobile marketplace that connects shoppers with heavily discounted groceries nearing their best-by date at partner grocery stores across the United States and Canada. Through its iOS and Android apps, shoppers browse deals of up to 50% off on fresh produce, meat, dairy, and packaged goods, pay in-app, and pick the items up at a dedicated Flashfood Zone in-store. By routing surplus food away from landfills and onto dinner tables, the company reduces grocery-retail food waste while helping families save on their grocery bills. Flashfood is a consumer-facing app and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface.

providers.name: Gloset
providers.description: Gloset is a Mexican peer-to-peer marketplace for buying and selling pre-owned and new fashion — formal dresses, casual wear, handbags, accessories, footwear, jewelry, watches, sportswear, menswear, and swimwear.
